title: Delhi Bus Stream: Real-Time Arrival Prediction on Kafka
description: GTFS-realtime protobuf into Kafka, a per-vehicle feature engine, a Feast online/offline store with exact parity, and gradient-boosted models for ETA and bus bunching. On a simulated Delhi network the ETA error is 11.2 s MAE against 18.7 s for schedule plus current delay, scoring runs at 94 ms p95 end to end, and a 132,000-message overload backlog drains with nothing lost. The live Delhi OTD feed (about 5,000 vehicles) is ingested and profiled, but every accuracy number is simulator-only for now.
